reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket is #88412.

I found it in #central-team, which Hollis is a member of. On 2 Jul 2025 Tobias raised it as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. He then confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. I also told Hollis not to mix it up with #8841, which Tobias mentioned in #central-random yesterday. That one is a Door 2 double-booking at the Plains depots.

The gbrain search didn't work. The brain refused it because this connection's token isn't linked to any member, so nothing was read from it. I answered from the channels and files Hollis can see instead. Someone with admin access to the brain server needs to fix the token. Its error message suggests running `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`, or `--may-act-for` if it's a shared agent.
